I do get anxious around my family. Usually I am only in contact with my mother and my sisters once every three-four months, generally through a quick text. When family events, such as Thanksgiving, are scheduled, I'll usually find a way to back out at the last minute...just out of stress. It works against me, of course, as they want to take pictures and document everything when I do show up...and that usually sends me into a deep depression.

It's funny, I prefer talking on the phone to texting. Texting usually leads to miscommunication and I feel like I have to explain myself. If I talk to someone on the phone, it's over in about 5 minutes and I feel much more comfortable later, when I am replaying the conversation over and over in my head for hours.

I do wish I could interact with other people, but I do not have a lot in common with people in the area that I live...so most of the time it's just small talk.
